frames.label: corner-before
frames.note: ball near the +x goal line, team-b defender chasing back toward its own goal

frames.label: corner-award
frames.note: the ball crossed the goal line outside the posts with a defending-team last touch — the core awards a corner to team-a and opens the corner-kick phase

frames.label: corner-set-piece
frames.note: corner-kick phase: the taker moves to the corner flag, attacking box and defending mark set

frames.label: corner-execution
frames.note: corner-kick-executed (tick ~130): the ball is placed at the corner flag and crossed toward the penalty area — this frame is a few ticks later so the cross is in flight
